flags.text: Operating margin up 300 bps over 3 years
Only 46% of 5y profit showed up as operating cash
Cash cycle stretched by 27 days in 2 years (-28 → -1)

guidance.promise: Maintain export growth tempo in the coming months
guidance.quote: We expect exports to continue to maintain the growth tempo in the coming months.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Aim to outpace industry growth in 125cc plus segment in next 2-3 months
guidance.quote: We will aim to outpace the industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and continue the path of acquiring market share which commenced in the period of September-October.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Maintain three-wheeler sales of over 100,000 units per quarter
guidance.quote: We expect E-auto performance to get unlocked due to the removal of supply constraints and we intend to capture a higher share of the improving ICE auto market, maintaining the growth tempo and sales of certainly over 100,000 units per quarter.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.quote: Secondly, sustained export momentum with 15%-20% growth with emphasis on superior positions in better markets.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

claims.claim: Q2 topline reached almost Rs. 15,000 crores, growing at 14%
claims.quote: We closed the quarter, as you know, with a topline of almost Rs. 15,000 crores, growing at 14%, an all-time high.

claims.claim: EBITDA crossed Rs 3,000 crores with 20.5% margin
claims.quote: EBITDA crossed Rs 3,000 crores, another all-time high with the EBITDA percentage of 20.5%.

claims.claim: PAT came in close to Rs. 2,500 crores
claims.quote: PAT came in close to Rs. 2,500 crores, yet another all-time high.

claims.claim: Free cash flow generated around Rs. 4,500 crores in H1 FY26
claims.quote: we generated around Rs. 4,500 crores of free cash in the first half of this year, which is a conversion of almost 100% of the profits after tax.

pushback.topic: GST rate impact on customer behavior
pushback.quote: If you can sort of share a little bit more perspective on what you have seen post-GST in terms of customer behavior
Just looking to hear your thoughts on, is it opening up of new markets, is it stabilization, or there were some license issues and fidget restrictions.
Also what is the update on the ABS norms coming up? How much impact can that have on the cost as well as demand in your assessment?

calls.tone: Confident, optimistic, and transparent regarding record-breaking milestones and strategic responses.

guidance.promise: Expect export volume run rate to reach 200,000 units plus in Q4
guidance.quote: In fact, this quarter, which is quarter 4, we expect hopefully that we will turn in a 200,000 unit plus performance.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Expand joint KTM-Triumph showrooms to over 100 by March
guidance.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Complete top management team exercise for KTM AG by 1st April
guidance.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Expect motorcycle industry to continue to grow at 12% to 15%
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

claims.claim: Top line crossed INR15,000 crores with 19% growth, EBITDA at 20.8%, and PAT crossed INR2,500 crores.
claims.quote: We closed the quarter with a top line of over INR15,000 crores, an all-time high with 19% growth. EBITDA came in at over INR3,100 crores at 20.8%, another all-time high and PAT crossed INR2,500 crores

claims.claim: Exports crossed 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters with 18% year-on-year growth.
claims.quote: surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters. Last time this happened was in Q3 FY2022. The business grew at 18% year-on-year this quarter in volume terms

claims.claim: EV portfolio contributes 25% of domestic revenues with individual segments crossing INR1,000 crores.
claims.quote: our EV portfolio comprising both electric 2-wheelers and 3-wheelers now contributes to a staggering 25% of domestic revenues. And individually, both the segments... crossed INR1,000 crores of quarterly revenues each

claims.claim: BACL generated INR200 crores PAT in Q3 with AUM over INR16,000 crores.
claims.quote: It delivered a PAT of INR200 crores in Q3 itself... and now has an AUM of over INR16,000 crores

pushback.topic: Export growth outlook and run rates
pushback.quote: And this 200,000-run rate seems to suggest that, that 20% run rate can continue even though export volumes seem to be closer to the previous peak made during COVID.

pushback.topic: Commodity cost inflation lag and pricing actions
pushback.quote: So, when you talk about this 50-60 bps, does it factor in the commodity prices that we are seeing on the screen today? Or will today's commodity prices as we see it is that something that will hit us maybe with the quarter's lag, say, in the June quarter?

pushback.topic: Domestic volume growth convergence to industry growth
pushback.quote: So, over the next couple of quarters, as you mentioned, with your market share recovery efforts and potential product launches, do you see your own volume growth converging to that mid-teens level that the industry could grow versus the current sort of low single-digit run rate?

calls.tone: Confident and optimistic about record-breaking performance, strategic market share recovery, and successful turnaround actions.

guidance.promise: Push exports to 220K plus levels per month this quarter
guidance.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

claims.claim: Record Q4 performance with revenues crossing INR16,000 crores and margins at 20.8%.
claims.quote: Quarter 4 was a standout quarter with revenues crossing INR16,000 crores, EBITDA at INR3,300 crores and margins at 20.8%.

claims.claim: Full year FY26 delivered record revenue exceeding INR58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR12,000 crores.
claims.quote: Record revenues at INR58,000-plus crores, record EBITDA crossing INR12,000 crores for the first time with margins at 20.5%

claims.claim: Chetak crossed 1 lakh retail mark for the first time in a single quarter.
claims.quote: In quarter 4, Chetak crossed the 1 lakh retail mark for the very first time in a single quarter, the highest ever quarterly retails for the brand.

claims.claim: Board approved 100% profit payout via dividend and buyback.
claims.quote: Lastly, the Board of Directors at its meeting earlier today approved a payout of 100% of the profits that we have made last year

pushback.topic: Price hike impact on demand and export growth
pushback.quote: Sir, I just want to go back to the comments you mentioned about the price hike and related impact on demand.

pushback.topic: Commodity inflation impact and pricing actions
pushback.quote: So, any thoughts on our appetite to take more price hikes? And what is really the tolerance level when you think about the range of margin?

pushback.topic: Motorcycle growth moderation and service availability
pushback.quote: Amyn Pirani: Thanks for the opportunity and yet another congratulations going your way, Rakesh. I have two questions. The first one is on your comment on the moderation in the motorcycle growth.

calls.tone: Optimistic and confident while addressing supply chain and inflationary challenges.

guidance.promise: Move exports to beyond 250,000 per month level this quarter and onwards
guidance.quote: Overall, the exports business, which like I said is 40% of our revenue, has established an outstanding growth momentum and we are looking at moving exports to beyond the 2,50,000 per month level this quarter and onwards.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Expand capacity by 25% from 7 million to 9 million units per annum in medium term
guidance.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Accomplish exhaustive portfolio makeover of 150cc and 125cc segments within next 6 weeks
guidance.quote: Our aim is to accomplish this exhaustive portfolio makeover within the next 6 weeks. So, by the time we meet next in October, we should be able to give you some early reports of their acceptance.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Unlock Chetak EV capacity to 60000 units in immediate term
guidance.quote: And then, of course, to address your specific question on Chetak, it will be about 60,000 units in the immediate term.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

guidance.promise: Introduce 2 new brands in 125cc segment during the year
guidance.quote: Further, in the year, we aim to introduce 2 new brands in the 125cc segment to cover the full spectrum of customers in this large segment as well as proposition customers from the 100cc segment to upgrade.
guidance.speaker: Rakesh Sharma

claims.claim: Delivered highest quarterly performance across volumes, revenue, EBITDA, and PAT in Q1 FY27
claims.quote: So, quarter 1 has built further on the record-breaking financial year '26 by delivering the highest quarterly performance across all parameters.

claims.claim: Generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during the quarter at 80% conversion
claims.quote: We generated over INR2,300 crores of free cash flow during this quarter, almost double that of the same period last year, translating into a cash conversion of almost 80% of profit after tax.

claims.claim: Consolidated revenue crossed INR21,689 crores and PAT reached INR3,226 crores up 46% YoY
claims.quote: standalone revenues of INR17,200 crores translated into consolidated revenues of INR21,689 crores, reflecting a 65% year-on-year growth, while consolidated profit after tax came in at INR3,226 crores for the quarter, up 46% year-on-year.

claims.claim: Electric two-wheeler and three-wheeler businesses delivered largest ever quarter at 30% domestic revenues
claims.quote: Taken together, our electric two-wheeler and three-wheeler businesses delivered their largest ever quarter and are now at 30% of domestic revenues with double-digit EBITDA percentage.

pushback.topic: Demand divergence between lower and upper segments
pushback.quote: So, is it the customer preference or that is changing very rapidly? Or is it that the customer in that segment itself is facing some kind of stress?

pushback.topic: Wholesale market share decline in motorcycles
pushback.quote: So, is this a new direction in which we are focusing more on the premium segment, and the overall market share could keep coming down and that is a strategic direction?

pushback.topic: Surplus cash accumulation and shareholder payout options
pushback.quote: Do you want to continue through the buyback route, which gets restricted for a year period? Or you want to start going through the dividend route, you increase your payout ratio and that gives a greater predictability on how much you're going to pay out each year?

calls.tone: Confident and resilient, highlighting record performance despite severe headwinds and volatile operating environment.

Excise, service tax, GST, and customs matters under dispute.

promise_ledger.delivered: Timeline extends into next reporting period; product-level updates are pending management's October report.

promise_ledger.delivered: Medium-term target is currently underway; unit capacity is not reported in quarterly financials.
promise_ledger.quote: So, with an eye on the future, we are undertaking an expansion of capacity by almost 25% from the current 7 million units per annum across different businesses to progressively go up to 9 million units per annum.

credibility.line: Management consistently beats revenue and export volume targets, though cash conversion lags reported net profits.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed record revenue exceeding ₹58,000 crore for FY26; reported annual revenue reached ₹62,905 crore.
Despite strong PAT claims, cash generation remains weak with FY26 OCF/PAT at 0.25 and 5-year conversion at 0.46.
Management boasts strong balance sheet performance, but borrowings ballooned 13.8x in 3 years to ₹26,401 crore by Sep 2026.

bull: Sep 2026 revenue grew 59.7% YoY to ₹25,126 crore, sustaining high top-line momentum.
FY26 EBITDA reached ₹13,097 crore at a 21.0% margin, meeting profitability goals.
Export run rate targets successfully scaled up to over 250,000 units per month by Q1 FY27.
bear: Borrowings rose from ₹1,912 crore in Mar 2024 to ₹26,401 crore in Sep 2026, driving D/E to 0.72.
Cash conversion is weak, with FY26 operating cash flow covering only 25% of reported PAT.
Quarterly EBITDA margin compressed 200 bps from 21.0% in Jun 2026 to 19.0% in Sep 2026.
watch: Improvement in OCF/PAT ratio from FY26 level of 0.25.
Sustained export monthly volume exceeding 250,000 units.
Leverage trajectory following debt rise to ₹26,401 crore.
